Gate before the real run: plant power >= 0.8 at the unfiltered-5-pages mechanism, specificity <= 0.03. bars_v3/panel-R36 declared N/A in PREREG (zero panel readings; no decode by charter).

result: NEGATIVE at real power. T1 G=67.94 p=0.2764; T2 Z=+0.539 p=0.4890; T3 minp=0.0208 family-p=0.4647 - nothing within an order of magnitude of the 0.00333 bar. CONSEQUENCES: (1) A4-H10's literal mechanism (unfiltered pages) EXCLUDED at measured power 0.975; >=4x elevations at 0.743. coverage: Page-granularity rate heterogeneity on the 55-segment unsolved stream in the binomial family, three registered statistics at family alpha 0.01, D=10,000 bootstrap, with a measured power curve (0.975 at unfiltered-5-pages, 0.743 at 4x, 0.312 at 3x, 0.128 at 2.5x); the five blind-flagged pages individually under x55 control.
not_covered: Serial/ordering structure across pages and sub-page drift: G/Tarone/min-p are exchangeable-across-pages statistics, blind to smooth regional trends by construction - W2-B3's T7 LOUD FLAG (gap lag-1 autocorrelation p=0.0010, block-scale heterogeneity) is neither confirmed nor retired by this row; the two results are compatible (smooth multi-page variation too mild for per-page overdispersion). The T7 follow-on needs an ordering-sensitive registered test with its own plant.
Elevation shapes other than the planted 5-page subset (1-page, 20-page, section-boundary shapes have different power curves).
